Health Care | Representative Dwight Evans Skip to main content Share your story with my office! Health Care Everyone has a right to affordable and accessible health care. That’s why, since coming to Congress, I have fought alongside my Democratic colleagues to defend, strengthen, and expand the Affordable Care Act, Medicare, and Medicaid. I was proud to vote for President Biden’s landmark Inflation Reduction Act, which capped the out-of-pocket cost of prescription medication at $2,000 a year for seniors, gave Medicare the power to negotiate prescription drug prices, and helped lower the price of insulin to $35 a month. With this historic health care law, Democrats took on big pharma and won, delivering for the American people! As the Trump Administration and Congressional Republicans continue attacking our health care system, from freezing NIH grants for life-saving medical research to targeting access to gender-affirming and reproductive health care, I am fighting back to protect access to affordable health care for  all . Serving on the Ways and Means Subcommittee on Health, which has jurisdiction over many aspects of our health care system, including Medicare and the Hospital Trust Fund, allows me to place Philadelphia at the forefront of national health care policy discussions. From bolstering our health care infrastructure and workforce to increasing access to healthy, nutritious foods, I’m committed to being a strong advocate for health care laws that give everyone in our community the access and resources they need to keep themselves and their families healthy and safe. For additional information about my work on health care, read more below or contact my office  here . Housing | Representative Dwight Evans Skip to main content Share your story with my office! Housing I am a firm believer that housing is an essential human right! Everyone deserves access to safe, accessible, affordable housing. And building this housing and keeping other housing in good condition is key to creating and maintaining livable communities. I know that our city, our commonwealth, and much of our nation currently have an affordable housing crisis. Addressing this crisis involves significant investments in our housing infrastructure and expanding fair housing protections. As a member of the influential tax-writing Ways and Means Committee, I am continuously advocating for expansions of the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit. In Congress, I am also fighting to deliver critical housing investments back into our community. I have secured funding for  local projects  throughout the Third District, including ones to build housing units that serve severely underserved women and elderly veterans, increase affordable housing for low-income seniors, and create critically needed affordable homeownership options for Philadelphians who otherwise could not purchase their homes. For more information about my work on housing, read more below or contact my office  here . More on Housing Evans Introduces Bill to Build More Accessible, Affordable Housing August 10, 2026 Press Release PHILADELPHIA (Aug. 10, 2026) – U.S. Rep. Dwight Evans (D-PA-3) introduced the Visitable Inclusive Tax Credits for Accessible Living (VITAL) Act to strengthen the Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) to expand the supply of affordable, accessible housing for older adults and people with disabilities. Evans’ lead House co-sponsor is Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick (R-PA-1), and U.S. Sens. Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) and Kirsten Gillibrand (D-NY), ranking member of the Senate Special Committee on Aging, introduced companion legislation in the Senate. Jobs, the Economy, & Small Businesses | Representative Dwight Evans Skip to main content Share your story with my office! Jobs, the Economy, & Small Businesses I am a firm believer that America’s economy must work for people on Broad Street- not just billionaires. That we should not be putting corporations over Cobbs Creek or Wall Street over West Philly. I’m fighting in Congress to help build a thriving economy for  all Americans.  As a member of the influential Ways and Means Committee, which oversees taxes, trade, Social Security, and Medicare, I am advocating for poverty-busting policies such as restoring expansions of the Child Tax Credit and the Low-Income Housing Credit. Moreover, I am fighting for the Earned Income Tax Credit, one of our biggest, most useful tools to reduce poverty and put hard-earned money back into workers’ pockets. A thriving economy is key to building stable neighborhoods in Philadelphia and beyond. Our small business owners are the engines that drive investment in our neighborhoods and spur economic development, block by block. I will continue to fight for small businesses in the Third Congressional District. As part of building a fair economy for all, we must ensure workers’ rights to organize and bargain collectively are protected. I am proud to be a supporter of the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, which would safeguard workers’ ability to unionize free from employer harassment, intimidation, or retaliation. For additional information about my work on jobs, the economy, and small businesses, read more below or contact my office  here . Veterans | Representative Dwight Evans Skip to main content Share your story with my office! Veterans The brave men and women who courageously served our armed forces have put their lives on the line to protect our fundamental freedoms, and for that, we owe them more gratitude than we can express. To our veterans and active military — we thank you today and always. Just as no one is left behind on the battlefield, we must leave no veteran behind when they return home. As our veterans return home, we have an obligation to ensure that they have access to critical health care, education and financial resources. That’s why I’m proud to have voted for the historic PACT Act, the largest expansion of veterans’ health care and benefits in three decades. This law expanded access to care and benefits for veterans exposed to toxic substances during their service and their loved ones. Representing the Corporal Michael J. Crescenz VA Medical Center in Congress, I know we need to strengthen the VA - not cut services. In the face of continued attacks from the Trump Administration on this critical agency, I’m fighting to protect the  earned  benefits and services that veterans and their loved ones rely on. For additional information about my work on veterans, read more below or contact my office here . If you need help with accessing your veterans benefits or with a claim at the VA, please contact my casework team  here . Climate Change & the Environment Science is clear: climate change is real and poses a present danger that threatens the health of our communities, our infrastructure, and our economy. And these threats disproportionately impact low-income communities and communities of color, including in Philadelphia. I was proud to vote for President Biden’s Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and Inflation Reduction Act, a landmark clean-energy and health care law. These historic pieces of legislation have provided billions in funding to the Philadelphia region. From upgrading our water system to repairing our roads and bridges to expanding our electric-vehicle charging infrastructure, this funding continues delivering for communities across Philly! Faced with an administration that is trying to move us backwards, I’m fighting in Congress to protect and build on this progress, working to create a cleaner, greener Philadelphia for generations to come. Immigration I am a strong supporter of comprehensive immigration reform. I believe in an immigration reform system that keeps families united and develops a path to citizenship. The incredibly aggressive efforts by the Trump Administration to detain and deport law-abiding immigrants when those resources could be allocated to violent offenders represents a misplaced diversion of resources. Arresting, let alone deporting, someone for free speech, having tattoos, or even wearing a Michael Jordan jersey, is outrageous, un-American, and I continue opposing these abuses of the Trump administration. As we move through these uncertain times, please know my office is here for Philly's immigrant communities. It is crucial that everyone, regardless of their immigration status, knows they have rights and what they are! My office has created a Know Your Rights and Resources page.
